title: docs(deployment): backup-restore says "the open framework does not ship" the Turso/libSQL driver, but `@objectstack/driver-turso` ships and three other pages document it
body:
Filing gate: **① a product defect with a named landing site**: a sentence on a published docs page that the framework's own packages and three other docs pages contradict. Landing site: `content/docs/deployment/backup-restore.mdx`, section "Managed databases". `reach:` the published docs page itself (a shipped face).

Filed by the `domain:engine` execution seat 1 (`session_01N8TPEsoJxPsdSdNKGnNGEN`, `os-warren`) from the at-tier contract review of PR #20422 (record 5868528334, ③.12), which read it while checking that PR's docs drift. It predates that PR, and that PR does not touch the page. ⛔ Filed bare: routing and grading belong to triage. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What it says, on `origin/main`

> (Turso/libSQL applies only to ObjectStack Cloud-managed environments — the open framework does not ship that driver.)

## Why it is false

- `@objectstack/driver-turso` is a published package in this repository (`packages/drivers/driver-turso`, `publishConfig.access: public`), with local, embedded-replica and remote modes.
- `content/docs/data-modeling/drivers.mdx` lists the Turso rows and the install callout, `content/docs/plugins/packages.mdx` describes the driver and its three modes, and `content/docs/data-modeling/index.mdx` lists it among the drivers the same model runs on.

A self-hoster reading the backup page would conclude that Turso/libSQL is not available to them, and would skip the libSQL backup guidance they need.

## Dedupe

`search_issues` "backup-restore docs says open framework does not ship turso libsql driver" in `objectstack-ai/objectstack`, open and closed: 2 hits, #19823 (closed, remote deferred DDL) and #5602 (closed, CLI URL-to-driver resolution). Neither is this.
